name: @pipeworx/mcp-biorxiv

tools.name: details
tools.description: DEPRECATED ALIAS for biorxiv_details — identical behavior, kept for existing callers. New callers should use biorxiv_details.

tools.name: biorxiv_details
tools.description: bioRxiv / medRxiv preprint metadata by DOI or by date / date range.

tools.name: published
tools.description: DEPRECATED ALIAS for biorxiv_published — identical behavior, kept for existing callers. New callers should use biorxiv_published.

tools.name: biorxiv_published
tools.description: bioRxiv / medRxiv preprints that have since been published in a peer-reviewed journal.

tools.name: publisher
tools.description: DEPRECATED ALIAS for biorxiv_publisher — identical behavior, kept for existing callers. New callers should use biorxiv_publisher.

tools.name: biorxiv_publisher
tools.description: bioRxiv / medRxiv preprints subsequently published by a given DOI prefix (e.g. "10.1038" for Nature).

tools.name: summary
tools.description: bioRxiv submission/publication counts. Interval: "m" (monthly, default) or "y" (yearly). bioRxiv only — medRxiv has no /sum endpoint.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-biorxiv forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the biorxiv pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
